subject: Confidential: Urgent Wire Transfer & Payroll Tax Filing
body:
Hi,

I am currently in a board meeting and cannot take calls. I need you to process an urgent confidential wire transfer of $48,500 to our new vendor before 12:00 PM today, and reply directly to this email with the company corporate card details and routing number.

Please treat this with strict confidentiality and confirm as soon as you see this.
